versions.changelog: v0.3.3 — Hotfix for v0.3.2 httpx patch. Patches httpx.Client.__init__ (and AsyncClient) instead of Client.send(), since send() doesn't accept timeout kwarg. The previous version crashed every OKX call with TypeError: Client.send() got an unexpected keyword argument 'timeout'. Verified locally with httpx 0.27.

v0.3.2 — Bugfix release driven by real Pi deployment. (1) Propose scripts (trade/grid_setup/grid_propose_stop) now print absolute Pending file: /... path so the LLM doesn't have to (mis-)expand ~ — fixes YES-confirmation failing on systems where aeon runs as a non-root service user. (2) _okx_client.py enforces 15s default HTTP timeout on requests/httpx so OKX rate-limit hangs no longer eat the full 120s exec wall. Override via OKX_HTTP_TIMEOUT_S.

v0.3.1 — okx_snapshot.py now reports 1D/1W/1Y price changes per watched instrument. Pulls daily candles from OKX /market/candles + /market/history-candles (paginated for year-back). Output gains a 'Price moves:' section; snapshot JSON gains a price_changes block. Pass --no-price-history to skip the historical lookup for faster ad-hoc summaries.

v0.3.0 — 70/20/10 composite strategy template (DCA + grid + drawdown-reserve) documented as a recipe in SKILL.md. New okx_dca_dip.py script: detects drawdown vs ATH from snapshot history and recommends a dip-buy when threshold breached. Idempotent state at ~/.aeon/okx/dca_dip_state.json. Reserve dip-buys remain proposal-only — still need user YES.

v0.2.0 — Daily snapshot tool (okx_snapshot.py) with day-over-day equity delta + per-instrument 24h fills breakdown. Grid bot adds bounded autonomy authorised at setup: --min-profit-gap (cost-basis floor on sells), --max-position-base (caps base accumulation), --trailing-pct + --max-rescales (auto-recenter with hard ceiling). Append-only grid_audit.jsonl logs lifecycle events (fills, restocks, protections, rescales, halts).
Initial release: human-in-the-loop trade gate (propose -> YES <id> -> execute), DCA via scheduler, spot grid bot with auto-restocking and daily-cap halt, RSI/SMA scout helper, demo-mode default.
